excerpt.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
excerpt.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

scope.zh: on_terraforming_complete → 隐藏随机池 terra.10 的全部22个结果、各自条件与权重，以及后续（辐射植物项目、武器贮藏遗址三阶段、冰封异种十年后的休眠者）。
scope.en: on_terraforming_complete → all 22 outcomes of the hidden pool terra.10 with conditions and weights, and follow-ups (Radiotrophic project, Weapons Cache dig site, Hibernators ten years after Suspended in Ice).

uncertain: Weapons Cache dig failures use the shared all_random_events incidents (ancrel.80xx), only linked.

label.zh: 每颗星球首次改造完成时最多出现其一
label.en: At most one per planet, on its first completed terraforming

note.zh: 隐藏事件 terra.10 的 random_list：各项权重2–5（蜂巢“真一”0.5），另有30为什么都不发生；每项都有星球类型、原星球类别、DLC或帝国类型的排除条件。
note.en: random_list in hidden terra.10: weights 2–5 (hive 'Oneness' 0.5) plus 30 for nothing; each entry is excluded by planet class, original class, DLC or empire type.

texts.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
texts.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

label.zh: 我们可以用得上更多的住房。
拓展这个星球的能量生产力。

tooltips.zh: 这个星球添加2发电区划

label.en: You can never have enough mines.

tooltips.zh: 这个星球添加2采矿区划
这个星球添加2农业区划

label.zh: 把这些设备拆解了就好。

texts.zh: 环境改造[From.GetName]完工得比原先估计的要快，这给了我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一些额外的时间开展一些实验，实验结果十分引人注目。这颗行星的自然特质得到了强化，既有美学情操，又保证了实用主义。
texts.en: Terraforming on [From.GetName] has finished faster than initially estimated, which has left our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] with time to experiment, and the results are impressive. The planet's natural traits have been enhanced to be both aesthetically pleasing and utilitarian.

label.zh: 它非得看上去这么人工吗？
label.en: Does it have to look so artificial?

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上的漫长项目令人沮丧地结束了，只取得了一部分成功。在对最后的几处山谷进行地形变动时，生物质重调器发生了功能异常，导致我们创造出了一大滩环境改造残余物。尽管对于殖民者不构成危险，它还是意味着这个星球目前会有一点狭窄。
texts.en: Our long project on [From.GetName] has frustratingly ended in partial success. As the final valleys were undergoing terramorphing, a malfunction occurred in the biomass realigner, leading to the creation of large swaths of Terraforming Residue. While not dangerous to our colonists, it means that the planet is a bit more cramped for the time being.

texts.zh:
我们为了唤醒[From.GetName]而进行的漫长项目，结果不如预期般顺利。我们的一处生物质重组器发生破裂，释放了少量环境改造残留物，堵塞了山谷并在某些可居住区域形成一层粘性外壳。

虽然这对我们本身没有危险，但这种过多的脓状物质意味着我们一些更具移动性的单位可能会在一段时间内遇到困难。
texts.en:
Our lengthy project to awaken [From.GetName] has not resolved as successfully as we had hoped. A rupture in one of our biomass realigners has released a minor deluge of Terraforming Residue, clogging valleys and forming a sticky crust over certain habitable zones.

While not inherently dangerous to us, this excess of pus-like material means some of our more motile elements may struggle for a time.

texts.zh: 我们不仅成功地对[From.GetName]进行了环境改造，我们还做得更加好了。在定稿阶段的最后，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]设法想让这个星球成为我们本土动物群的完美家园，创造一个同[Root.GetHomeWorldName]及其相似的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。我们的所有本土植物也会移植到那里去，只是地形会不太一样。
texts.en: We have not only succeeded in terraforming [From.GetName], but we have done something even better. During the final stretch of the process, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to make it a perfect home for our local fauna, creating a [From.GetPlanetMoon] eerily similar to [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. All our local plant life is there but none of the familiar terrain.

label.zh: 这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]应该作为[Root.GetHomeWorldName]二号被人所知
label.en: This [From.GetPlanetMoon] shall be known as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] II

tooltips.en: Sets the name of [From.GetName] to [Root.GetHomeWorldName] II

texts.zh: 正当[From.GetName]的环境改造工程即将收尾之时，一个独特的情况发生了。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现，我们有可能将这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]变为潮汐锁定。这样的现象如果自然发生了，可能会对殖民地造成危害。然而，如果是在环境改造的过程中这么做，我们就能充分利用昼半球无穷无尽的太阳时长，产出极其丰富的能量。我们当然也要制定一个集中计划，将我们剩余的工业园区和住房布置在夜半球或晨昏线地区。
texts.en: A unique situation has occurred on [From.GetName] just as the terraforming efforts are winding down. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have discovered that it's possible to tidally lock the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. This occurring naturally can be quite a detriment to a colony. However, doing it during the terraforming process could allow us to exploit the endless solar hours the dayside will receive and generate an obscene amount of energy. We would still have to make a concentrated effort to set up the rest of our industry and housing on the twilight and night side.

label.zh: 让[From.GetPlanetMoon]再次转起来，这么做风险太大了。
label.en: Set the [From.GetPlanetMoon] spinning again, the risk is too great.

tooltips.zh: 解锁一项特殊的殖民地决议，能够彻底解锁这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]的全部潜势。
tooltips.en: Unlocks a special Colony Decision to unlock this [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s full potential.

texts.zh: 随着[From.GetName]环境改造完工，我们发现这一工程使我们处在了一个始料未及的情况。我们实际上需要的资源，并没有我们最初立项的时候预计完成项目所需要的那么多，现在我们有机会为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]增添一项额外的特征。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]呈递给了我们三个不同的选项。
texts.en: As the terraforming of [From.GetName] is settling down, we discover that the project has put us in an unanticipated situation. We did not need as many resources as we initially set aside to finish this project, and now we have the chance to add-on one additional feature to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have presented us with three different options.

label.zh: 我们可以使用更多的发电区划。
label.en: We could use more Generator Districts.

label.zh: 看看我们是不是能够为采矿区划提供更多空间。
label.en: See if we can't develop more space for Mining Districts.

label.zh: 这个星球用得上更多的农业区划。
label.en: This world could use more Agriculture Districts.

texts.zh: 在将[From.GetName]转变为[This.GetAAnPlanetClass][This.GetClassAdj]星球的过程中，[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]筹划着不仅将当地动物群连接到主脑，还想将这个星球本身也连接到主脑，尽管有点担心暴露在环境改造气体中有可能诱发突变。蜂群现在有机会在更加真实的感知下，变得前所未有地完整。
texts.en: While turning [From.GetName] into [This.GetAAnPlanetClass] [This.GetClassAdj] world, the [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to link not only the local fauna to the mind but, through freak mutations when exposed to the terraforming gases, link the mind to the world itself. The collective now has the opportunity to become whole in a truer sense than before.

label.zh: 不，这不是这个星球的意图。
label.en: No, this is not the intention for this world.

texts.zh: 对于蜂群来说，超越自然不是什么新鲜事。在对[From.GetName]进行地形改造的过程中，每一座山峦都经过了考量，每一片动物群的放置都经过了战略推演。这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]现在变成了一处组织完美的后勤天堂，方便我们的[Root.GetUnitDronePlural]为蜂群整体的建设添砖加瓦。
texts.en: Surpassing nature is not something new for this collective. During the terraforming process of [From.GetName], every hill was considered, and every piece of fauna was strategically placed. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has now ended up being a perfectly organized logistical paradise for our [Root.GetUnitDronePlural] to produce for the collective.

texts.zh:
在为[From.GetName]土地施肥和导入大气的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]有个意外的发现。在[From.GetName]的地表以下存在一个地下外星文明。应该是由于[From.GetPlanetMoon]的矿物密度导致此前我们的扫描仪并未发现他们。
这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎完全没有意识到行星的地表已经改变，这让我们有了决定如何与他们接触的主动权。
texts.en:
While enriching the soil and adding an atmosphere to [From.GetName], our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have made an unexpected find. Beneath the surface of [From.GetName], there exists a civilization of subterranean aliens. It must have been because of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s mineral density that our scanners didn't detect them before.
The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem unaware that their surface has changed, giving us a chance to do what we will with them.

label.zh: 就是说地底下有害虫咯。
label.en: So the pests scurry underground now.

label.zh: 看到宇宙并不缺乏智慧生物还挺好的。
label.en: It's good to see that the universe is not devoid of intelligent life.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一开始以为某块地只是[From.GetName]上的一个臭气袋子，结果没想到那里竟是一块福地！它喷发出来的有毒气体实际上是未经精炼的异星天然气。有了这处全新的自然资源，为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]引入大气层所需的能源巨幅下降了，我们还可以在接下来的很多年采集这里的天然气！
texts.en: What our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] first took for a nasty gas pocket on [From.GetName] has turned out to be a blessing! The toxic fumes it was releasing are an unrefined version of Exotic Gas. With this new natural resource, the energy required to introduce an atmosphere to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has drastically decreased, and we can harvest the gas for years to come!

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]就[From.GetName]上的情况即带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。好消息是环境改造进程十分的顺利，我们有了一处美轮美奂的盖亚星球。坏消息是，所有住在这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的人都暴露在了环境改造气体中，已经不能适应非盖亚星球的环境了。这些“囿于盖亚”的居民在盖亚星球上生活时，展现出了惊人的生产力提升。相比于没有受到环境改造气体影响、在改造之后才过去的移民，这些居民的表现要好得不知道到哪里去了。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have good news and bad news for us about [From.GetName]. The good news is that the terraforming process went swimmingly, and we have a beautiful Gaia World. The bad news is that everyone living on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was exposed to the terraforming gases and now can't live on non-Gaia Worlds. These Gaia-trapped inhabitants have surprisingly been showing an increase in their productivity while on the Gaia World. Far better than workers that weren't affected by the gas that migrated there later.

label.zh: 至少他们看上去没有感到不舒服。
label.en: At least they don't seem to be uncomfortable.

texts.zh: 在我们派往[From.GetName]的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]之中，似乎有部分人是某个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上古老宗派的追随者。这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]相信寰宇之中有一处留给我们人民的天堂，结果他们选择不去寻找，而是亲自去创造这处天堂。[From.GetName]现在被转变成了一处被赐福的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，宛如从我们古老历史的宗卷中显现出来的图景。
texts.en: Amongst our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] assigned to [From.GetName], there seem to have been followers of an ancient sect from [Root.GetHomeWorldName] among them. These [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe that there is a paradise for our people, and instead of looking for it, they have now created it. [From.GetName] has now been turned into a [From.GetPlanetMoon] of the blessed, looking like an illustration manifested from the pages of our ancient history.

texts.zh: 我们的环境改造工作者完成了前所未有的功绩！阅尽整个[Root.GetName]的历史，总有一桩神话或传说流传下来，讲述许诺给我们人民的赐福之地——一处天堂。当我们驶向繁星却无处寻觅这处福地时，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]启动了一项计划，要亲自将这个传说化为现实。现在，[From.GetName]的地平线在我们面前向远方延伸，人人肃然起敬，心知我们亲手缔造了属于自己的天堂。
texts.en: Our terraformers have outdone any of their previous work! Throughout [Root.GetName], history there have always been myths and legends about a blessed land for our people, a paradise. When we set out to the stars and didn't find the Land of Bliss, a project to make it a reality was started by our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural]. Now the awe-inspiring horizons of [From.GetName] stretch before us, and we know that we have made our own paradise.

label.zh: 它只是个普通的盖亚星球吧？
label.en: It's just a normal Gaia World?

texts.zh: 在清除[From.GetName]大气层和土壤中的辐射的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不求助于我们的异星生物学家。他们发现了一个物种，依靠辐射繁衍生息，而现在正在枯萎。更令人惊奇的是，这个物种看上去还处于未开智状态，但将将就要进化出智能了。现在，随着最后一处泥土即将冲刷干净，我们必须决定如何处置这个新生命。
texts.en: While cleaning out the radiation in [From.GetName]'s atmosphere and soil, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to call in our xenobiologists. They had found a species that seemed to thrive off the radiation and was now wilting. Even more curious, this species appears to be presapient and on the cusp of achieving sentience. Now, as the final soil scrubbers are approaching, we have to decide what to do with this new life.

texts.zh:
我们刚刚从[From.GetName]的大气和土壤中清除了又一层辐射，为未来的自己铺平了道路。然而，我们警觉的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不介入并暂时隔离了这个世界的某些区域。我们的行动似乎惊扰了一种极其难以捉摸的本土物种，它们在放射性环境中茁壮成长，但由于我们的干预，它们已经开始枯萎。

更令人费解的是，这种物种似乎正处于未开智的阶段，但即将迈向智慧的进化关口。如今，随着[From.GetName]即将完全清除最后的有害环境，我们面临一个重要抉择：如何对待这一新生而独特的生命形式？
texts.en:
We have freed our future selves from another layer of radiation in the atmosphere and soil of [From.GetName]. However, our watchful [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to intervene and have temporarily isolated part of this world. We appear to have disturbed an extremely elusive native species that thrives in radioactive environments. Unfortunately, due to our actions, it has begun to wilt.

Even more curiously, this species appears to be presapient: they are on the cusp of achieving independent thought. Now, as [From.GetName] is poised to purge the last of its hazardous environmental legacy, we must decide how to handle this novel form of life.

label.zh: 我们毁掉了它们的栖息地，现在我们应当保护它们。
label.en: We have destroyed their habitat, now we have to preserve them.

tooltips.zh: 400未开智£pop£辐射合成人口会添加至[This.GetName]。
tooltips.en: 400 presapient £pop£ Radiotrophic Pops will be added to the [This.GetName].

label.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
label.en: Why not let them join us?

label.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
label.en: Why not let them join us?

label.zh: 这个世界是他们的。我们应该让他们觉醒。
label.en: This world is theirs. We should let them awaken.

tooltips.zh: 解锁辐射合成特质用于基因修饰。
tooltips.en: Unlocks the Radiotrophic trait for genemodding.

label.zh: 尽管无法应用到我们身上，但它们的基因物质可能有用。
label.en: While not applicable to us, their genetic material could be useful.

label.zh: 我们何苦要担忧这些杂草呢。完成环境改造。
label.en: Why are we even bothering with this weed. Finish the terraforming.

label.zh: 我们何苦要担忧这些杂草呢。完成环境改造。
label.en: Why are we even bothering with this weed. Finish the terraforming.

texts.zh: 这些可以在极高辐射强度的星球下存活并繁衍兴盛的植物可以作为我们帝国绝佳的补充。不过在此之前，我们需要提升他们的心智并在数月内教会它们我们数千年来的进展。
texts.en: These plants that can live and thrive on worlds with more radiation than atmosphere could be an excellent addition to our empire. But before then, we will need to enhance their minds and teach them thousands of years of progress in a few months.

texts.zh: 在花费数年调整这些我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]上发现的辐射合成植物，并且使其适应环境之后，我们现在可以将他们纳入我们的社会了。尽管这个物种还出人意料地年轻，但是他们看上去非常擅长收集能量。
texts.en: Having spent years acclimating and adjusting the radiotrophic plants found on [FromFromFrom.GetName], we now are ready to allow them into our society. While an incredibly young species, they seem to excel in harvesting energy.

tooltips.zh: 600£pop£辐射合成人口加入我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: 600 £pop£ Radiotrophic Pops will be added to our Empire.

texts.zh: 恢复一个死寂星球是一项艰苦的工作，而且十分单调重复：隔绝一块区域，清理所有的卵石，替换土地，净化任何残留的水源，添加新的动物。随着[From.GetName]的环境改造进程逐渐扫尾，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现了一个规模可观的地下金属容器，根据其防御工事，我们假定这是一个武器库。
texts.en: Restoring a Tomb World is always hard work and often very repetitive: section off an area, clear out any rubble, replace the soil, purify any remaining water, and add new fauna. As the terraforming process on [From.GetName] was winding to a close, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] discovered a sizeable underground metal container, and based on its fortifications, it is assumed that this is a weapons cache.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]破碎地面的下方发现了一个大型加固贮藏室。考虑到在这样一个充满辐射的废土，还有其被埋葬的年份，我们很惊讶它居然完好无损。
texts.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

sections.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]破碎地面的下方发现了一个大型加固贮藏室。考虑到在这样一个充满辐射的废土，还有其被埋葬的年份，我们很惊讶它居然完好无损。
sections.en: A large reinforced cache has been found underneath the broken ground of [From.Planet.GetName]. It's surprisingly intact considering the years it spent buried in a radioactive wasteland.

texts.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的贮藏室并不好挖掘，因为它的发现地点被深深地埋在了城市废墟之下。又因为不管容器里面储藏着什么，我们都被要求谨慎行事避免将其误触发，发掘进度被进一步地拖慢了。现在这栋建筑矗立在我们的面前，等待我们随时开始调查。复杂的外星文字被刻在贮藏室的两侧，或许能提示我们里面有什么内容物。
texts.en: The cache on [From.Planet.GetName] was not easy to unearth, as it was buried deep below the ruined city in which it was discovered. The excavation effort was further slowed by the caution required to avoid setting off whatever is stored in the container. Now the structure stands before us and is ready to for investigation. Complex alien script is carved into the sides of the cache that might hint at its content.

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]完成了翻译外星人的铭文，发现贮藏室外刻着一个警示。“在战争时期，任何情况下，都不允许任何政府进入这座军械库！”

无论这里面储存着什么武器，那对于一整个文明都具有足够的毁灭性，能够将他们化成灰。我们剩下的工作就是小心地打开这座军械库，然后拿到我们的奖励。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have finished translating the alien inscriptions and have discovered a warning engraved into the cache. "Do not under any circumstances allow any government to have access to this armory during wartime!"

Whatever weapon was stored here was too destructive even for a civilization that was capable of reducing themselves to ash. All that is left is to carefully open the armory and claim our prize.

texts.zh:
似乎是我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将“图书馆”错误翻译成了“军械库”。我们一直对“权力的来源”一词存在错误的理解，直到我们打开了贮藏室，看到了更多的外星文本。“如果你在读这一段，那说明我们从战争中存活了下来，现在准备开始重建。当我们星球的局势变得愈发恶化的时候，我花费了许多个月份创建这座图书馆，我的朋友和我忠实的同事一直陪伴左右。但既然你在读这一段，那说明我们中的某人幸存了下来，因此请好好接受这一份遗产。我和我的朋友收集到的，所有有关我们人民文化的成果，都集中在这里。你们第一个看见这个的人，将成为我最亲爱的朋友的象征。”

在饰板的下面，是一个双足哺乳动物的遗体，以及一个四足长鼻子动物的金属雕像。
texts.en:
It seems like our [Owner.GetLinguists] mistranslated the word 'library' as 'armory'. We had assumed the incorrect meaning of 'source of power', which was only apparent after opening the cache and being greeted by further xeno script. "If you are reading this, that means that we survived the war and are now ready to rebuild. I spent many long months creating this library while our world's situation worsened, accompanied by my friend and faithful companion. But since you are reading this, that means that someone did survive, so please take part in your heritage. All the cultural works of our people my friend and I could gather are collected here, and let the first you see be a representation of my dearest friend."

The remains of a bipedal mammal and a metal statue of a four-legged long-snouted animal stands under the plaque.

label.zh: 说好给我们武器的，把图书馆和雕像融化掉用来造导弹。
label.en: We were promised weapons, melt the library and statue down and use it for missiles.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的气候进行干化改造，使得整个星球新近显露的海床上出现了一个巨大的熔岩隧道网络。

形成这些深层隧道的岩浆流现在已经休眠，留下了富饶的矿脉，这些矿脉是在很久以前[From.GetName]熔融核心的极端高温和高压下形成的。

这些火成矿藏非常密集；在此地的开采作业成本高昂，但利润丰厚。
texts.en:
Drying the climate on [From.GetName] uncovered a vast network of lava tubes throughout the planet's newly-exposed ocean floor.

The magma flows which created these deep tunnels are dormant now, leaving behind a rich seam of minerals forged long ago in the extreme heat and pressure of [From.GetName]'s molten core.

These pyroduct deposits are extremely dense; extraction operations here will be costly but highly lucrative.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的环境改造工程意外引发了本地动物种群数量的激增。

我们发现，许多本地物种的繁殖周期与环境中的水资源供应密切相关。它们的卵原本需要在土壤中埋藏数月，吸收足够的水分后才能孵化，如今却大量散布在地表。该星球的动物数量正以对数级速度迅速增长。

这些生物中许多都富含营养，将为[From.GetName]提供丰富的食物来源，同时也为研究一个极其活跃的生态系统提供了机会。前往该星球的访客现在需要在离开时接受严格的筛查程序，以防止对外界造成污染。
texts.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] has caused an unexpected surge in the native fauna population.

We have discovered that the breeding cycles of many local species are intrinsically linked to the availability of water in the environment. Their eggs, which previously were buried in soil for months before absorbing enough water to hatch, are now littering the landscape in abundance. The planet's fauna numbers are skyrocketing at a logarithmic pace.

Many of these creatures are highly nutritious; they will provide an abundant food source for [From.GetName], as well as opportunities to study an extremely active ecosystem. Visitors to this planet will now be required to undergo an extensive screening process upon departure to prevent outworld contamination.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]的行星环境改造过程中，意外发现了大量埋藏在地表冰层中的本土生物。更令人惊讶的是，这些生物竟然仍然存活。

该物种似乎正处于一种异常深度的冬眠状态，这是它们应对[From.GetName]漫长冰河期的有效生存策略。然而，星球改造过程中的解冻现象提前结束了它们的休眠状态。

从冰封的沉睡中苏醒后，这些生物已经展现出初步的智慧迹象，并在觅食过程中使用简单的工具。

它们将立即被消灭。我们将把产生的生物质用于我们自己的目的。
texts.en:
Our terraforming efforts on [From.GetName] revealed a surprising number of native fauna buried within the surface ice. Even more astonishing is that these creatures are somehow still alive. 

The species appears to have been in the midst of an exceptionally deep hibernation; an effective method for surviving [From.GetName]'s lengthy ice ages. Thawing caused by the terraforming process has prematurely brought their stasis to an end.

Roused from their icy slumber, the creatures are already demonstrating glimpses of intelligence, utilizing simple tools in their food-gathering efforts.

They will be exterminated without delay. We will harvest the resulting biomass for our own purposes.

它们独特的生理结构将为我们提供丰富的食物来源。

Their unique physiologies will provide us with a rich food source.

我们可以研究该物种非凡的冬眠能力，或者为了获取生物质而收割这些生物。

We could either study this species' remarkable hibernation capabilities or harvest the creatures for biomass.

We should protect these life forms. Their remarkable hibernation capacities warrant further study.

texts.zh:
对[event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName]上的欠智慧生物种群的研究揭示了其非凡的休眠模式。这种模式由一种特定的酶调控，该酶触发了生物体进入和退出深度休眠状态的过程。在这种状态下，其体内的化学反应几乎降至可忽略不计的程度。

我们提取了这种酶，并成功通过镇静化合物将其应用于其他多种生物。在所有案例中，原本不具备休眠能力的物种都能够进入长时间的休眠状态，在此期间细胞老化显著减缓。

这一非凡的突破为人工增强的冷冻休眠铺平了道路，将大大减轻有机物种在长距离太空旅行中的身体负担。
texts.en:
Studies of the pre-sapient population on [event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName] produced insights into their remarkable hibernation patterns. They are regulated by a particular enzyme which triggers the body's entry into and exit from deep stasis sleep. In this state, chemical reactions within their bodies are reduced to almost negligible amounts.

We extracted this enzyme and have been able to administer it successfully - via sedative compound - to various other organisms. In all cases, species previously incapable of hibernation were able to enter into a lengthy dormancy which significantly reduced cell aging for its duration.

This extraordinary breakthrough paves the way for artificially-enhanced cryosleeps that will greatly reduce the physical strains of long distance space journeys for organic species.

texts.zh:
我们的环境改造专家已对[From.GetName]上即将出现的问题发出警告。

在这颗星球的冰冻山脉之下，蕴藏着大量高丰度的铁和碳资源，这些资源在环境改造过程中被过度加热。

我们现在可以安全地移除这些接近熔化的资源。或者，通过让过度加热持续下去，我们将培育出一个永久的合金来源。当然，这将以减少宜居生活空间为代价。
texts.en:
An impending issue on [From.GetName] has been flagged by our terraforming specialists.

Beneath the frozen mountain ranges of the planet lie vast, highly concentrated deposits of iron and carbon, all of which were superheated by the terraforming process.

We could safely remove the near-molten resources now. Alternatively, by allowing the superheating to continue, we would foster a perpetual source of alloys. Of course, this would come at the cost of habitable living space.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]进行的环境改造产生了意想不到的后果。我们未曾意识到，该星球表层的土壤是一种含有高浓度易爆微粒的细颗粒混合物，而我们的改造过程扰动了这些微粒，并将其散布到了整个星球的大气中。

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，[From.GetName]的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
texts.en:
Terraforming on [From.GetName] had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of Volatile Motes which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

Unfortunately, these airborne high-energy particles increase the risk of unintended combustion events on the surface. Any future colony will have to prioritize accident and conflict prevention in order to avoid devastating consequences.

However if we are able to manage the dangers carefully, the atmosphere of [From.GetName] will become a rich source of these rare materials.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的行星地壳因环境改造过程而发生位移，导致了一种不寻常的自然现象。

移动的构造板块使多个异星天然气气穴发生位移，这些气体与行星火山中富含合金的矿脉发生反应，导致火山喷发呈现出鲜艳的蓝色。

这一现象的不稳定性使得行星的宜居性有所下降，从而影响了我们为[Root.GetColonistPlural]们创造居住空间的计划。

作为额外的好处，这些火山周围的土地现在富含资源，可供我们利用。
texts.en:
The planetary crust of [From.GetName] has shifted as a result of the terraforming process, leading to an unusual natural phenomenon.

The shifting tectonic plates have displaced several pockets of Exotic Gases which have reacted with the Alloy rich mineral deposits found in the planet's volcanos, causing their eruptions to develop a vivid blue hue.

The volatile nature of this phenomenon has left the planet a bit less hospitable, and as a result impacted our plans to create livable space for our [Root.GetColonistPlural].

As a bonus, the earth around these volcanoes is now rich in resources for us to take advantage of.

texts.zh:
我们收到报告，在[From.GetName]上出现了一种新兴的天气现象。

在星球的环境改造过程中，地壳中的水晶矿床暴露出来，并与改造过程中使用的化学物质发生反应，进而受到辐射。由此引发的空气温度波动导致了一场覆盖整个星球的持续雷暴。

这种独特的天气条件将不可避免地影响基础设施的建设，而受到辐射的水晶矿床也必然会对长期宜居性产生影响。然而，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，一旦环境改造完成，他们就能够利用这些风暴的能量。

此外，我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]也制定了安全中和水晶矿床电荷的计划。这将消散风暴，并使我们能够安全地开采这些水晶用于其他用途。
texts.en:
We have received reports of an emerging weather phenomenon on [From.GetName].

Crystal deposits within the bedrock of the planet have become exposed during terraforming, reacting to the chemicals used in the process and becoming irradiated. The resulting fluctuations in air temperature have created a perpetual planet-wide lightning storm.

These unique weather conditions will inevitably impact infrastructure development, and the irradiated crystals are sure to have consequences for long-term habitability. However, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident they can harness the energy of the storms once terraforming is complete.

Alternatively, our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have also drawn up plans to safely neutralize the charge in the crystal deposits. This should dissipate the storms and allow us to safely harvest them for other uses.

label.zh: 利用这些风暴中的能量。
label.en: Exploit the energy in these storms.

label.zh: 中和这些晶体里的电荷。

texts.zh:
当我们完成在[From.GetName]的环境改造后，尸体开始从天而降。

从如此高的高度坠落，这些古老的遗骸在撞击时化为肉泥。与内脏一起，我们发现了一些小物件的集合——装饰性的器物和奇异的遗迹——它们都从星球高层大气中相同的浓密云层中坠落。

这些厚重的云层，我们只能推测是被某种未知的外星物种用作最终的安息之地，现在正因我们的星球改造而变得稀薄，并释放出之前悬浮在其中的物品。我们可以预见，随着大气稳定，这些遗骸将继续坠落，直到云层墓穴完全空空如也。
texts.en:
As we finished terraforming on [From.GetName], bodies began falling from the sky.

From such heights, these ancient carcasses are reduced to a pulp upon impact. Amongst the viscera we have discovered clusters of small objects - ornamental instruments and odd relics - all tumbling from the same dense clouds in the planet's upper atmosphere.

These thick clouds, which we can only assume were utilized as a final resting place by some unknown alien race, are now thinning as a result of our terraforming changes and releasing the contents that were previously suspended inside. We can expect these remains to continue falling as the atmosphere settles, until the cloud graves are emptied entirely.

label.zh: 令人毛骨悚然，但没准也能淘到点啥。

notes.zh: 审阅说明：与其他“奇异世界”事件不同，此项的排除条件是“已触发过且拥有生物起源DLC”，没有要求必须拥有该DLC（terraforming_events.txt:503-514）。
notes.en: Review note: unlike the other strange-world entries, this one is only excluded when already triggered AND BioGenesis is owned; it does not require the DLC (terraforming_events.txt:503-514).

summary.text:
# 环境改造 / Terraforming

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/terraforming_events.txt:133–518（隐藏随机池 terra.10）、520–1640、events/strange_worlds_terraforming_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2118（on_terraforming_complete）· 部分结果需要 DLC：霸主、植物人物种包、远古遗物、生物起源 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

一颗星球环境改造完成时（on_terraforming_complete），隐藏事件 terra.10 检查：星球位于非荒野帝国的领域内、此前没改造过（terraformed_once）、不是遗迹/城市世界、可以拥有宜居矿藏。随后从一个随机池中最多抽一件事，权重30为什么都不发生。每颗星球只会抽一次。
When a planet finishes terraforming, hidden terra.10 (once per planet, not relic/city worlds, not wilderness empires) draws at most one event from a weighted pool; weight 30 means nothing happens.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

随机池中的结果（权重与条件）/ Pool entries (weight, condition):

- 过剩的环境改造设备（3，殖民地且有空余区划）、改造的美景（3，非死寂世界）、环境改造难题（3，空余区划少于4）。
- ［母星］二号（2，改造成本国理想星球类别，非母星，每国一次）、行星策略（2，非殖民地且非由荒芜/死寂改造而来）、成功过头（3，非荒芜起源、非盖亚）。
- 真一（0.5，蜂巢）、完美的组织（2，格式塔），二者均排除荒芜/死寂改造。
- 出土［前超光速文明］（2，荒芜改造且有霸主DLC）、有所帮助的瑕疵（3，荒芜改造）。
- 未曾预料的突变（2，盖亚殖民地、使用消费品、非生命播种/进化掠食者起源）、［星球］此处便是天堂（2，盖亚、非格式塔、非母星、每国一次）。
- 辐射植物（2，死寂世界改造，植物人物种包，尚未取得辐射营养基因）：可保护、启蒙（项目“启蒙辐合植物”→“辐光四溢的招待会”，新物种加入）、采集基因或继续改造。
- 武器贮藏室（2，死寂世界改造，远古遗物，每国一次；地球为50倍）：创建考古遗址，三个阶段“揭开尘封的过去”→“军械库”→“翻译错误”。
- 生物起源的奇异世界（各5，每国一次，按改造前后的星球类别）：矿化熔岩隧道、遇水即活的卵、冰封异种（狩猎/研究/保护后3600天出现“休眠介质”）、钢之山、可燃大气（需已发现易爆微粒）、蓝色熔岩、永恒闪电、天空墓穴。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 池中各项互斥，一次改造最多一件；不同星球的改造可以各自抽到不同事件，标为“每国一次”的不会重复。
  Entries are exclusive per terraforming; "once per empire" entries never repeat.
- 有后续的只有：辐射植物的启蒙项目、武器贮藏室遗址、冰封异种的休眠介质。
  Only the Radiotrophic project, the Weapons Cache site and the Hibernators have follow-ups.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 多个事件的选项按蜂巢/机械/格式塔、排外、进化掠食者等改变；“天空墓穴”的排除条件写法特殊（见审阅说明）。
  Options vary by empire type and ethics; Sky Burials has an unusual exclusion clause.
